mapper.select: SELECT r.recipient_id AS safeAccountId, r.recipient_id AS recipientId, r.bank_code AS bankCode, b.bank_name AS bankName, r.account_no AS accountNo, r.holder_name AS holderName, r.account_alias AS accountAlias, TRUE AS isVerified, r.safe_registered_at AS createdAt FROM recipients r JOIN banks b ON r.bank_code = b.bank_code WHERE r.senior_id = #{wardId} AND r.is_registered_safe = TRUE ORDER BY r.safe_registered_at DESC
